name: agent-kit
description: Generic skills, hooks, commands and scripts for agents that work on a repository: reply templates and their lint, metrics skills, the task janitor, and a contract-tests method.

plugins.name: reply-style
plugins.description: Reply templates for agents that report to a repository owner, with a lint and a Stop hook.

plugins.name: metrics
plugins.description: Two skills for a central metrics service: join it with a repository, and read its summary and act on it.

plugins.name: task-janitor
plugins.description: Task janitor for an issue tracker and Claude Code sessions: a read-only report, a session matcher, a status board, and their commands.

plugins.name: contract-tests
plugins.description: A method for end-to-end contract tests that run without a person, a client binary, a browser sign-in or a model call.
